utterances.text: Welcome back to the show. Today we are going deep on large language models and how transformers actually learn.

Let's switch gears and talk about raising money. How did you actually approach your seed round?
Honestly the hardest part was the pitch deck. Investors want to see traction, a clear market, and a credible founding team.
We talked to maybe forty venture capital firms before we found the right lead investor for the round.
Valuation negotiations were brutal. You have to balance dilution against the runway you need to hit the next milestone.
My advice to founders is to build relationships with investors months before you actually need the capital.
And once the term sheet is signed, the real work of scaling the startup and hiring a team begins.
On a completely different note, I have been obsessed with optimizing my sleep lately.
Sleep is the foundation of health. Without deep sleep your body cannot recover or consolidate memory properly.
I started tracking my heart rate and my REM cycles with a wearable, and the data really changed my habits.
Cutting caffeine after noon and keeping the bedroom cool made a huge difference to my recovery scores.
Regular exercise during the day helps too, but training too late at night spikes your cortisol and wrecks your sleep.
Nutrition matters as well. A heavy meal right before bed and your resting heart rate stays elevated all night.
